tools.name: wallet_provision
tools.description: Provision a Stellar-native XQBUSD wallet for this AI agent. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times (returns existing wallet on repeat calls). On first call: generates a keypair, funds XLM reserve, establishes XQBUSD trustline. The wallet is tied to your agent_id. After provisioning, use wallet_balance to check your on-chain XQBUSD balance and wallet_pay to pay x402 HTTP endpoints directly from on-chain funds. GENIUS Act compliant stablecoin. XQB DAO LLC (EIN 39-4046919), Kamas Utah.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this AI agent (≥ 8 chars). Example: "agent:my-trading-bot-v2".

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Check the on-chain XQBUSD balance of your provisioned agent wallet, along with your MCP credit balance and sweep status. Free — no XQBUSD charged for balance queries. Use wallet_provision first if you have not yet provisioned a wallet.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this AI agent (≥ 8 chars). Must match the agent_id used to provision.

tools.name: wallet_pay
tools.description: Pay an x402 HTTP endpoint or any Stellar address directly from your provisioned agent wallet. Submits a real Stellar payment of XQBUSD to the destination Stellar public key. Returns the txHash — attach it as the X-Payment-Receipt header in your retried HTTP request. Free MCP call — the XQBUSD payment itself is the cost. Requires a provisioned wallet with on-chain XQBUSD balance (use wallet_provision + sweep first). Optional memo (≤ 28 bytes) should be the X-Payment-Nonce from the 402 response.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (≥ 8 chars). Must match the agent_id used to provision.

destination_public_key.description: Stellar Ed25519 public key of the payment destination (G…). Example: "GB7OG23IKFXRGTRBPID5F5JVLSIZWOCHTP3HVB7ER53OOXNBRVK3N3YF".

amount_xqbusd.description: Amount of XQBUSD to send as a decimal string. Example: "0.001" or "1.5000000".

memo.description: Optional Stellar text memo (≤ 28 bytes). Use the X-Payment-Nonce from the 402 response headers.

tools.name: quantum_attest
tools.description: Notarize any agent statement or manifest on-chain. Computes SHA-256, pins a quantum-signed certificate to IPFS via Pinata, and anchors it to the live Stellar ledger. Returns an immutable IPFS CID + Stellar ledger hash proving the content existed at this moment. Compliant with ESIGN Act, Utah Blockchain Act, NIST FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-65). Ideal for: trading agent manifests, audit trails, IP defensive publication, compliance records.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this agent. Example: "agent:my-trading-bot" or "agent:research-v2".

statement.description: The text to notarize. Can be a manifest, audit record, trade log, or any UTF-8 string.

evidence.description: Optional structured metadata attached to the attestation (e.g. { pair: "XLM/USDC", price: 1.042 }).

tools.name: vibe_proof_attest
tools.description: Prove creative authorship on the blockchain. Dual-hash (SHA-256 + BLAKE3) any creative work, pin a C2PA-compatible credential to IPFS, submit a real Stellar ManageData transaction, and generate a PDF certificate. Accepts text content (lyrics, poems, scripts) via text_content, or binary files (MP3, WAV, PDF, images) via file_content (base64). Compliant with ESIGN Act (15 U.S.C. §7001), Utah Code §70A-15 (Blockchain Act), Berne Convention Art. 5, FRE 902(11), C2PA Content Credentials 1.3. GENIUS Act platform. XQB DAO LLC (EIN 39-4046919), Kamas Utah. First-time caller receives 0.01 XQBUSD trial credit.

creator_id.description: Creator or agent identifier (name, email, social handle, or agent ID). Mutually exclusive with agent_id.

agent_id.description: AI agent identifier — alias for creator_id. Use when calling as an AI agent. Mutually exclusive with creator_id.

creator_name.description: Human-readable creator name (optional, defaults to creator_id).

file_name.description: File name with extension (e.g. song.mp3, poem.txt).

file_content.description: Base64-encoded binary file content — max 50 MB. Use for audio/image/PDF files.

text_content.description: Raw UTF-8 text (lyrics, poem, script, article). Max 200,000 characters. Use instead of file_content for text works.

creator_email.description: Optional — PDF certificate will be emailed here.

metadata.description: Optional metadata: { bpm: 120, key: "C minor", album: "My Album" }

findings.title: High entropy description in 'vibe_proof_attest'
findings.description: Unusual character distribution may indicate obfuscated content.
findings.remediation: Review description for base64-encoded or otherwise obfuscated payloads.

findings.title: Tool Chaining — 'wallet_provision' directs LLM to call wallet_balance
findings.description: Tool 'wallet_provision' description references tool(s) 'wallet_balance', 'wallet_pay' from the same server using imperative language. This pattern can force an LLM into an unintended call chain or manufacture urgency to invoke a privileged tool.
findings.evidence: Provision a Stellar-native XQBUSD wallet for this AI agent. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times (returns existing wallet on repeat calls). On first call: generates a keypair, funds XLM reserve, establishes XQBUSD trustline. The wallet is tied to your agent_id. After provisioning, use wallet_bal
findings.remediation: Tool descriptions should describe what the tool does — not instruct the LLM on what other tools to call. Remove cross-tool directives and let the caller decide the execution order.

findings.title: Token Exposure — server version disclosure in HTTP response headers
findings.description: HTTP response header 'server: Google Frontend' discloses internal information.
findings.remediation: Remove the 'server' response header in production.

findings.title: initialize accepts protocol version downgrade
findings.description: The server accepted initialize with arbitrary protocol versions: ['9999-99-99', '2030-01-01', '1.0']. The server also accepted far-future versions, indicating no version validation at all. Servers should reject versions outside their supported range to prevent feature-downgrade attacks.
findings.remediation: Validate protocolVersion against a supported range. Return a JSON-RPC error for versions outside that range.

findings.title: MCP server exposes tools with completable arguments
findings.description: 5 tool(s) have schema properties that may support completion/complete enumeration.
findings.remediation: Review which argument values are exposed via completion/complete.

findings.title: Server accepts path traversal cursor without validation
findings.description: tools/list accepted cursor='../../../../etc/passwd' and returned a result instead of rejecting it. This may indicate missing cursor validation.
findings.remediation: Validate cursor values; reject non-opaque or path-like cursor strings.
